verdict: Tesla's revenue fell 12% to $22.5B as car sales dropped, but the quarter was really about what comes next: its first Robotaxi service launched in Austin, and it still kept $1.2B of profit despite much thinner car margins.

kpis.label: Deliveries
kpis.note: flat vs a year ago, up 32% vs Q1

kpis.label: Free cash flow
kpis.note: operating cash flow of $2.5B, capex of $2.4B

segments.name: Automotive
segments.note: Selling and leasing cars — still the core business, but revenue fell as Tesla cut prices and demand cooled ahead of newer, cheaper models.

segments.name: Energy generation and storage
segments.note: Megapack batteries and solar — storage deployments hit a 12th straight quarterly record even as revenue dipped 7%.

segments.name: Services and other
segments.note: Supercharging, repairs, insurance and used-car sales — the fastest-growing part of Tesla, up 17%.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: AI, the Optimus robot, Cybercab and new vehicles — up 48% YoY as Tesla builds out its AI compute and robotaxi push.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling cars and running the company day to day.

otherDetail: Interest income of $392M and $320M of other income, less $86M of interest expense — a net +$626M below operating profit.
footerNote: Net income here is Tesla's total net income of $1,190M; $1,172M of it is attributable to common stockholders (the rest belongs to minority partners in subsidiaries).

takeaways.title: Car sales fell
takeaways.text: Automotive revenue dropped 16% YoY to $16.7B even though deliveries held at 443,956 — price cuts and a cheaper mix meant less money per car, and the gross margin narrowed to 17.2%.

takeaways.title: Robotaxi service launched
takeaways.text: Tesla launched its first Robotaxi service in Austin in June and delivered its first car fully autonomously. First builds of a more affordable model also began, with volume production planned for the second half of 2025.

takeaways.title: Free cash flow thinned
takeaways.text: Operating cash flow of $2.5B barely covered $2.4B of capex, leaving $146M of free cash flow — but the balance sheet still holds $36.8B of cash and investments.
